raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Wide-EP headless nodes are started without `--kv-transfer-config`, so ranks 8–15 never open their handshake and notify ports. After [vllm-project/router#386](https://github.com/vllm-project/router/pull/386) the router schedules all 16 DP ranks per role, and KV for ranks 8–15 does not transfer.

## Changes

`.buildkite/amd-disagg/vllm_disagg.sh`, `build_ep_cmd`:

- Pass MoRIIO `--kv-transfer-config` on the headless child and the master.
- `remote_hosts`: the other role's node IPs, master first.
- `remote_dp_size_local`: `GPUS_PER_NODE`. Rank `r` dials `remote_hosts[r / GPUS_PER_NODE]` at port offset `r % GPUS_PER_NODE`.
- NIXL stays master-only.
- `fill_remote_pod_from_config` copies those two fields onto the request when the router omits them. The decode rank holding the request sends the notify.

## Test Plan

```bash
# PREFILL MASTER — ranks 0-7
vllm serve /data/models2/DeepSeek-V3 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  -tp 1 \
  --data-parallel-size 16 \
  --data-parallel-size-local 8 \
  --data-parallel-address ${PREFILL_MASTER_IP} \
  --data-parallel-rpc-port 13345 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --all2all-backend mori_high_throughput \
  --port 20005 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --distributed-timeout-seconds 7200 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.75 \
  --enforce-eager \
  --api-server-count 8 \
  --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MoRIIOConnector","kv_role":"kv_producer","kv_port":"9711","kv_connector_extra_config":{"proxy_ip":"${PREFILL_MASTER_IP}","proxy_port":"10001","proxy_ping_port":"36367","http_port":"20005","local_ping_port":"61555","handshake_port":"6301","notify_port":"61005","remote_hosts":["${DECODE_MASTER_IP}","${DECODE_CHILD_IP}"],"remote_dp_size_local":8}}'

# PREFILL CHILD — ranks 8-15
vllm serve /data/models2/DeepSeek-V3 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  -tp 1 \
  --data-parallel-size 16 \
  --data-parallel-size-local 8 \
  --data-parallel-address ${PREFILL_MASTER_IP} \
  --data-parallel-rpc-port 13345 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --all2all-backend mori_high_throughput \
  --port 20005 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --distributed-timeout-seconds 7200 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.75 \
  --enforce-eager \
  --data-parallel-start-rank 8 \
  --headless \
  --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MoRIIOConnector","kv_role":"kv_producer","kv_port":"9711","kv_connector_extra_config":{"proxy_ip":"${PREFILL_MASTER_IP}","proxy_port":"10001","proxy_ping_port":"36367","http_port":"20005","local_ping_port":"61555","handshake_port":"6301","notify_port":"61005","remote_hosts":["${DECODE_MASTER_IP}","${DECODE_CHILD_IP}"],"remote_dp_size_local":8}}'

# DECODE MASTER — ranks 0-7
vllm serve /data/models2/DeepSeek-V3 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  -tp 1 \
  --data-parallel-size 16 \
  --data-parallel-size-local 8 \
  --data-parallel-address ${DECODE_MASTER_IP} \
  --data-parallel-rpc-port 13345 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --all2all-backend mori_low_latency \
  --port 20005 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --distributed-timeout-seconds 7200 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.75 \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"PIECEWISE","custom_ops":["+quant_fp8"]}' \
  --api-server-count 8 \
  --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MoRIIOConnector","kv_role":"kv_consumer","kv_port":"9711","kv_connector_extra_config":{"proxy_ip":"${PREFILL_MASTER_IP}","proxy_port":"10001","proxy_ping_port":"36367","http_port":"20005","local_ping_port":"61555","handshake_port":"6301","notify_port":"61005","remote_hosts":["${PREFILL_MASTER_IP}","${PREFILL_CHILD_IP}"],"remote_dp_size_local":8}}'

# DECODE CHILD — ranks 8-15
vllm serve /data/models2/DeepSeek-V3 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  -tp 1 \
  --data-parallel-size 16 \
  --data-parallel-size-local 8 \
  --data-parallel-address ${DECODE_MASTER_IP} \
  --data-parallel-rpc-port 13345 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --all2all-backend mori_low_latency \
  --port 20005 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --distributed-timeout-seconds 7200 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.75 \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"PIECEWISE","custom_ops":["+quant_fp8"]}' \
  --data-parallel-start-rank 8 \
  --headless \
  --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MoRIIOConnector","kv_role":"kv_consumer","kv_port":"9711","kv_connector_extra_config":{"proxy_ip":"${PREFILL_MASTER_IP}","proxy_port":"10001","proxy_ping_port":"36367","http_port":"20005","local_ping_port":"61555","handshake_port":"6301","notify_port":"61005","remote_hosts":["${PREFILL_MASTER_IP}","${PREFILL_CHILD_IP}"],"remote_dp_size_local":8}}'

vllm-router \
  --vllm-pd-disaggregation \
  --kv-connector moriio \
  --vllm-discovery-address 0.0.0.0:36367 \
  --port 30000 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --intra-node-data-parallel-size 8 \
  --policy round_robin \
  --prefill-policy round_robin \
  --decode-policy round_robin \
  --log-level info

lm_eval --model local-completions --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 \
  --model_args model=/data/models2/DeepSeek-V3,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64
```

## Test Result

| Model / config | Ranks per role | GPU KV cache (tokens/GPU) | gsm8k flexible-extract | gsm8k strict-match |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DeepSeek-V3 2P2D EP16/DP16 MoRIIO WRITE | 16 | prefill 4,389,120; decode 3,815,840 | 0.9484 ± 0.0061 | 0.9469 ± 0.0062 |
| Kimi-K2.5-MXFP4 2P2D EP16/DP16 MoRIIO WRITE | 16 | prefill 2,627,104; decode 1,731,584 | 0.9295 ± 0.0071 | 0.9295 ± 0.0071 |

nodes.body:
## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

The fill fixes notify, handshake and write routing, but the WRITE release path still targets the master pod. _release_write_prefill_blocks (moriio_connector.py:1007-1010) takes the host from remote_host or the request_id (the prefill master IP) and uses get_port_offset(remote_dp_rank, tp) with the global rank. It never reads remote_hosts, and its request_finished caller (:1620) runs before this fill. With this PR, prefill ranks 8-15 hold WRITE blocks. If a decode request is aborted before it is scheduled, the release for those ranks goes to master_ip:notify_port+8..15, which nothing binds, so the child keeps that request's KV blocks until defer_timeout (60 s default). The hybrid full-prefix-hit release at :1256 has the same problem. 2d2386a6c8 had the fix (fill plus a pod_index host and a fold_local_rank offset inside _release_write_prefill_blocks), and 893fbf1ca8 dropped it. Could you restore it? The code is pre-existing, but this PR is what makes it reachable on Wide-EP.

is_request_leader now defaults to True on every decode request whenever the serve config has remote_hosts and the router doesn't. That also turns off the "router did not pin remote_dp_rank" warning (moriio_connector.py:1232-1245). A router that omits remote_dp_rank now sends the notify to prefill rank 0 with nothing in the log, and the request waits until timeout. 2d2386a6c8 only set the leader when remote_dp_rank was present. 
May be:
```
if not is_producer and "remote_dp_rank" in params: params.setdefault("is_request_leader", True)
```
